S78.01.needs: A Free account and a paid account
S78.01.note: The resolver itself is in apps/extension/src/features/cloud-bridge/capabilityDocument.ts (the quoted lines at :15 and :36 no longer match). The controls read it through applyCapabilityGates in src/side_panel.ts.
steps: Sign in and open the + button in the composer. Note whether Upload from device is listed.
Sign out, then sign in with an account that has a different plan or settings, and open + again.
Compare: an option is hidden only when the account cannot use that feature.
S78.01.where: No control of its own. Effect shows in the composer + menu, where Upload from device is listed or hidden.

S78.02.needs: A Free account and a paid account, to compare
steps: Sign in and click the model button in the composer.
Pick a model that offers reasoning levels, then open the model button again and look for the Effort heading and the Extended thinking row.
Pick a model without reasoning options, reopen the model button, and check that Effort and Extended thinking change or disappear.
Click + and check whether Upload from device is listed for this account. Compare with Expected.
S78.02.where: Composer > model button (shows the model name) > Effort and Extended thinking rows; composer + > Upload from device

S78.04.needs: A paid account (some levels are gated)
S78.04.note: Whether an unsupported level is left out of the request was not checked in the UI; the cited request-processor line is in apps/web.
steps: Pick a model that offers several reasoning levels, then click the model button.
Under the Effort heading, read the list of levels and find the one marked Default.
Choose a different level and send a message.
Switch to a model with fewer levels, reopen the model button, and check the Effort list matches that model. Compare with Expected.

S78.07.note: The plan name shown on a locked row comes from the picker code, not a fixed message. The server check is not visible to a tester.
steps: Sign in with a Free account and click the model button.
Find a model row marked with a plan name on the right side. Hover it and read the tooltip or the row text.
Click the locked row and see that a plans page opens in a new tab.
Compare with Expected. The server-side check cannot be seen from the screen.
S78.07.where: Composer > model button > locked model row (plan name on the right) and Effort rows with a plan name

S78.08.needs: A signed-in account with some usage
steps: Sign in and click the More button at the top right of the side panel.
Read the Usage row, including its meter.
Click Usage. A web usage page opens in a new tab.
Compare the meter and the page with Expected.
S78.08.where: More (the three-dot button at the top right of the side panel) > Usage

S78.09.needs: A workspace member account and a workspace administrator policy
S78.09.note: Searched apps/extension/src and apps/extension/_locales for admin, organization, workspace, policy and retention text. Found no workspace policy screen. The only denial gate found is connectors coming soon in src/features/cloud-bridge/capabilityDocument.ts. The cited src/side_panel.ts:6168 quote is gone.

S78.12.needs: An account that is not eligible by age or account rules
S78.12.note: Searched apps/extension/src and _locales for age, 18, eligib and adult text. No age or eligibility check was found. The cited sign-in files are in apps/web or apps/extension-vscode, and apps/web/features/auth/AuthSwitchLine.tsx no longer exists.

labels.text: Desktop tools are optional and currently disconnected.

S78.14.needs: The AGI Desktop app installed on the Mac, and an account
steps: Make sure the AGI Desktop app is not running or not paired, then open the side panel.
Read the notice above the composer. It appears only while Desktop is disconnected.
Click Reconnect. Start the Desktop app and click Reconnect again.
Compare: the notice should disappear once Desktop is connected.
S78.14.where: Side panel > notice above the composer: Desktop tools are optional and currently disconnected.

S78.17.needs: A Free account and a paid account, to compare
S78.17.note: The Voice input mic button is also hidden when voice is not allowed (src/side_panel.ts), but that label is a literal title, not a message.
steps: Click the model button and pick a model that does not offer extended thinking. Look for the Extended thinking row.
Compare with a model that does offer it, where the row is listed.
Click + and check whether Upload from device is listed for this account.
Compare with Expected: a control that cannot apply is hidden, not shown disabled.
S78.17.where: Composer > model button (Extended thinking row) and composer + (Upload from device)

steps: Sign in with a Free account and click the model button.
Find a model row that shows a plan name on the right. It stays listed but cannot be picked.
Hover the row, or open the Effort list of a model, and read the gated level with its plan name and tooltip.
Compare with Expected: the restricted control is visible, disabled, and says which plan unlocks it.
S78.18.where: Composer > model button > locked model row (plan name on the right) and Effort row with a plan name

S78.19.note: The + row does not name a plan. The plan name appears on the model and Effort rows. What the row opens when clicked was not traced.
steps: Sign in with an account whose plan does not include video and click +.
Read the row Create a video · Upgrade.
Click the model button and read a locked model row or an Effort row with a plan name.
Compare with Expected: the surface names the plan that unlocks the feature and how to upgrade.
S78.19.where: Composer > + > Create a video · Upgrade (shown when the plan does not include video)

S78.21.needs: A website not yet on your approved sites
S78.21.note: The card is built by buildSiteGrantCard in src/features/side-panel/bubbles.ts and called from src/side_panel.ts around line 7902. The exact trigger was traced from code, not run. The approved-sites settings are in src/features/options/site-allowlist.ts.
steps: Open a website that is not on your approved sites.
In the side panel, ask AGI to read or act on that page.
When the card AGI needs access to the site appears, read its explanation text.
Look at the buttons Allow for this task, Always allow on this site and Decline. Compare with Expected.
S78.21.where: Side panel > an AGI task that needs to read or act on a site you have not approved yet (card titled AGI needs access to the site)

S78.22.needs: An account and a model that returns a plan or quota error
S78.22.note: The Switch model button opens the model menu. Whether the error text names a specific model was not confirmed; a separate notice names the fallback model.
steps: Send a message with a model whose request fails with a plan, quota or account error.
Read the failed reply and its error text.
Click Switch model. The model menu opens.
Compare with Expected: the user is told to use another model, and ideally which one.
S78.22.where: Side panel > a failed reply > Switch model button

labels.text: Send selected text to a local app…

S78.23.needs: A web page with text, and optionally a cloud chat for the phone path
S78.23.note: The destinations are AGI Desktop, VS Code and AGI CLI, built from the constants in src/features/context-handoff/index.ts. Continue on phone is in the More menu of a history item.
steps: Select a sentence on a normal web page, then right-click it.
Click Send selected text to a local app….
Read the dialog Send selected context? and its list of destinations. Do not click Send redacted context unless you want to send.
Compare with Expected: the surface offers an action that continues the work on another device or app.
S78.23.where: Right-click selected text on a web page > Send selected text to a local app… (dialog Send selected context?). Second path: side panel history item More > Continue on phone (cloud chats only).

S78.26.needs: A paid account, to see several models
S78.26.note: Whether unsupported parameters are removed from the request before sending was not checked in the UI. The code is in src/features/cloud-bridge/managedModelPicker.ts.
steps: Click the model button and pick a model that offers several Effort levels. Note the levels listed.
Pick a different model and reopen the model button.
Compare: the Effort levels and the Extended thinking row change to match the model. Unsupported levels are not offered.
S78.26.where: No control of its own. Effect shows in the composer model button > Effort and Extended thinking rows.

S78.28.needs: A paid account that can change plan, and a second browser tab
S78.28.note: The refresh code is in src/side_panel.ts around lines 13275 and 16387. Whether the side panel refreshes on its own without a reload was not run.
steps: Sign in to the side panel with an account whose plan you can change, keeping the side panel open.
In a separate tab, change the plan on the AGI web app.
Return to the side panel without reloading the extension. Click + and then the model button.
Compare with Expected: gated controls reflect the new plan without reinstalling or restarting.
S78.28.where: No control of its own. Effect shows in the composer + menu and the model button after a plan change on the web.
